data.name: Aabida
data.gender_notes: Aabida is used as a unisex name in islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Female worshipper; devout woman; she who worships (God)
data.long_meaning: From Arabic ʿābida (عابدة), the feminine active participle of ʿabada 'to worship, to serve', from the root ʿ-b-d. It is the feminine counterpart of ʿĀbid. Aabida therefore means “Female worshipper; devout woman; she who worships (God)”. Arabic feminine active participle ʿābida 'worshipper (f.)'; a standard Muslim female given name.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aabida expresses “Worshipper of God”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From Arabic ʿābida (عابدة), the feminine active participle of ʿabada 'to worship, to serve', from the root ʿ-b-d. It is the feminine counterpart of ʿĀbid.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aabida total 18, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.

faq.q: Is Aabida the feminine form of Aabid?
faq.a: Yes. Aabida (عابدة) is the feminine active participle of the same Arabic root ʿ-b-d, so it means 'female worshipper', the counterpart of the male name Aabid (عابد).

faq.q: What does the name Aabida mean?
faq.a: Aabida means “Female worshipper; devout woman; she who worships (God)”.

faq.q: Where does the name Aabida come from?
What is the linguistic root of Aabida?
faq.a: The root of Aabida is ع-ب-د (ʿ-b-d).

faq.q: How is Aabida written in Arabic script?
faq.a: Aabida is written عابدة in Arabic script.

faq.q: Is Aabida a boy's or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aabida is used as a female name.

faq.q: Does Aabida appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: No. Aabida is not a Qur'anic name; it is used in Muslim naming tradition.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Aabida verified?
faq.a: Yes — the meaning “Female worshipper; devout woman; she who worships (God)” is established by Arabic feminine active participle ʿābida 'worshipper (f.)'; a standard Muslim female given name..
